title: custom-dimensions bridge
description: One mod's bridge, config/custom-dimensions/bridges/<mod>.json: what of that mod's worldgen this pack adopts. Only a reviewed bridge counts. docs/design/rebuild-26/bridges.md.

mod.description: The Fabric mod id; the file is named <mod>.json.

reviewed.description: True once a human has tagged it; an unreviewed bridge adopts nothing.

structureSets.description: Structure sets that keep placing; every other set outside the pack's namespaces is switched off.

size.description: The measured footprint in blocks (T54); null until measured.

features.description: Placed features this mod adds to biomes that stay.

spawns.description: Entity types this mod adds to biome spawns that stay.

mixins.description: Mixin configs of this mod reviewed and allowed to enter worldgen classes.

registries.description: Dimensions, dimension types, noise settings, biome source and chunk generator types of this mod that are allowed.
